faq: Can you start from a brand new BigCommerce account?
Yes. If you have nothing yet, tell us your store name and what you sell in the order form. We start a store in your own account and hand it over, so you stay the owner from day one.
Which BigCommerce plan do I need?
Any standard plan works for the build. Your plan, theme license and paid apps are billed by BigCommerce and the app makers directly to you. Our price covers the work only.
We suggest two or three Stencil themes that suit your products and you choose. If you already bought a theme, we use it and set it up instead.
Do you write my product descriptions?
We add the products, images and options you supply. If you only have supplier data, we tidy it into a clean layout. Full copywriting is a separate service.
desc:
BigCommerce store setup and build turns an empty account into a shop ready for its first order. Ecom Swift LLC sets up your Stencil theme, products, payments, shipping, tax and core pages inside your own BigCommerce account.

## What is a BigCommerce store build?

A BigCommerce store build is the full setup of a working online shop. It covers the theme and branding, the product catalog, the payment gateway, shipping and tax settings, and the pages every store needs, such as home, category, product, contact and policy pages.

The store is created inside your own BigCommerce account, so you own it from the first day. When the build is finished, you can take real orders without further technical work.

## Why the first build decides how easy everything else is

Mistakes made at the start spread. Categories that do not match how people shop make navigation awkward. Product options entered inconsistently make filters unreliable. Shipping zones set up wrongly lead to orders you cannot fulfill at a sensible cost.

Fixing these after launch means editing many products and explaining changes to customers who already ordered. A careful build avoids that rework and gives you a store that is simple to manage as it grows.

## How a good build supports sales

Shoppers need to find a product, trust the store and pay without friction. A clean branded theme makes the store look credible. Clear product pages with sharp images and accurate options answer questions before they are asked. Visible shipping, returns and contact details lower the risk of buying from a store they have not used before.

Working payments, correct tax and sensible shipping rates matter just as much, because a failed checkout loses the sale entirely. We test the full path with an order before launch. Results after launch depend on your products, pricing and marketing, but a sound build removes technical reasons for lost orders.

## What a complete BigCommerce build includes

- A Stencil theme chosen and set up with your logo, colors and fonts.
- Your products added with images, descriptions, prices and options.
- Categories and navigation arranged around how customers shop.
- One payment gateway connected and tested.
- Shipping zones, carriers and tax settings that match where you sell.
- Home, product, category and contact pages, plus about, FAQ and policy pages.
- Custom home page banners and sections in the larger packages.
- Product filters, abandoned cart email, analytics and ad pixels in the fullest package.
- A mobile check and a test order before launch.
- A launch checklist and handover notes.

## How we build it

You send a short brief, your branding and your product list. We create or open the store in your BigCommerce account, set up the theme, add products in batches and connect payments. Then we configure shipping and tax, create the core pages and review everything on desktop and phone.

You see a private preview link before anything is public. We then place a test order to confirm that payment, shipping and email notices behave correctly. The Basic package covers a branded starter store with payments and shipping working. Standard adds a larger catalog, custom sections, policy pages and a test order. Premium adds product options, filters, email, tracking and a launch call.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Prepare product photos and descriptions before the build starts.
- Decide your shipping rules and return policy in advance.
- Keep product names and options consistent.
- Check the preview on your own phone.
- Test one real order before announcing the store.

**Avoid:**
- Launching before payments, shipping and tax have been tested.
- Copying manufacturer text word for word.
- Adding an app for every small feature.
- Using oversized images that slow pages.
- Hiding extra costs until the last checkout step.

## Who this is for

This service suits a new brand launching its first store, a seller with a supplier catalog who needs a professional storefront around it, and an existing business setting up a fresh BigCommerce store without moving data from another platform. You pay BigCommerce and any payment or app providers directly.

## What we need from you

A brief about what you sell, your logo and colors if you have them, your product list and your shipping details. We never need your password. You add us as a staff user or collaborator, or we guide you through opening the account yourself, and we keep you updated until the store is ready.
